coverage.text_review: Exhaustive review of main-step and remediation text blocks, including nested visual text, tables, captions, code walkthroughs and up-next previews.
coverage.sampling_method: Within each tile, select interaction positions 2, 5, 8, and so on. Review sampled prompts, options/items, constraints, feedback and learner task scaffolding for needs-to-understand dependencies.

reasoning_summary: Blocked-future boundaries were derived from the glossary contexts, with concept-level ordering also considered within each tile. Current-concept required facts were used to distinguish legitimate overlap from reliance on a later concept.
Distribution monitoring and drift interpretation do not require the later delayed-label cohort procedure. Matched-label evidence is introduced at the level supported by the current glossary facts.
Regression diagnosis names gated retraining as a supported response but does not require learners to understand retraining execution, durable admission or candidate acceptance calculations.

Trigger-policy stage annotations and separate promotion approval are explicitly current-concept facts. The execution API's ClientRequestToken is a supplied argument, not a requirement to understand the later durable idempotency contract.

Candidate expected error cost is a prediction-selection calculation, not later infrastructure workload cost attribution. Incident recovery does not depend on subsequent utilization, billing or cleanup concepts.

Utilization, cost attribution and cost guardrail examples remain within their own facts. Authorized instance stopping in the guardrail is explicitly taught there and does not require the later retired-resource cleanup procedure.
Up-next blocks preview subsequent lessons without making their procedures prerequisites for the current tasks. These previews are not leakage defects under the needs-to-understand criterion.
No deterministic gates were rerun. This verdict is limited to the exhaustive text and sampled-interaction leakage review, not a full assessment-key or final structural audit.
